code.commit_subject: variants FINDINGS 7: v14 stack WINS unseen at both seeds (179/177 vs 172/170, Fisher ~0.016; s8 adds first unseen moves win) -- adopted as lab recipe

conclusion: The original g24r4 MoveNet on the variants lab's 200-instance unseen-board exam: 101/200 at 7.78 moves - half the loop's solves, but wins both-solved moves 43/3 vs the loop line (the language-ceiling gap).
notes: Eval only (no new training); results/variants/baselines/forward_movenet_unseen.json; caveat: pre-rescue network (FINDINGS 86 applies to g16r8 only).
variant_conclusion: Kept as the quality bar: when it solves a puzzle its answer is nearly perfect, and no subgoal-based planner has matched that on solution length.
variant_description: A planner that plays the game forward one robot-move at a time, guided by a network taught from perfect solutions. When it solves a puzzle it is nearly perfect on solution length, but it searches slowly and gives up more often than the backward planner. Technically: a per-size MoveNet guiding A* over single moves.
